{{Short description|Russian mathematician}}
'''Lina Fazylovna Rakhmatullina''' (1932-2024) was a Russian mathematician and [[Honorary titles of Russia|Honored Worker of the Higher School of the Russian Federation]] who specialized in [[functional differential equations]]. Rakhmatullina was born in [[Tatarstan]] and defended her doctoral dissertation at the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]]. She led a research center on functional differential equations at [[Perm State University]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Bravyi |first1=E. |last2=Domoshnitsky |first2=A. |last3=Kiguradze |first3=I. |last4=Maksimov |first4=V. |last5=Malygina |first5=V. |title=Professor Lina Rakhmatullina (1932–2024). |journal=Funct. Differ. Equ. |date=2024 |volume=31 |pages=135–143}}</ref>

Rakhmatullina's doctoral students included Vladimir Maksimov.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lina Fazylovna Rakhmatullina |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=167088 |website=Mathematics Genealogy Project |access-date=17 April 2025}}</ref>
